items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I suggested that we get Bunk Johnson. Well, we got Bunk Johnson and by the time that he got there he was so darn high

ctx.x: Well, as an attraction, you know. People, you know... well, Sammy Price from Texas, slick dude, you know, smart and you know, know a lot of people, he's popular. You know,

because people come in, buy drinks and gamble and all that, and so he said...I suggested that we get Bunk Johnson. Well, we got Bunk Johnson and by the time that he got there he was so darn high that he didn't know where he was. I don't think Bunk even remembered even coming to Kansas City. 'Cause he stayed around there two or three days and we couldn't do anything with him at all. So we sent him back to New Orleans. He tried to play, but he couldn't play. And lost his cap and you know and all that business. But…
